rationale: Automatic repeated cold range-source admission may bind strict restricted full-Direct exchange coefficients into a complete GPU LR source. The default directly constructs the composite in one allocation; the separately controlled incumbent construction admits a temporary full source on identical canonical rows, FP64-combines it and releases it before SCF. One weighted K contraction replaces separately recomputed full K without changing the persistent source ceiling, precision, grids, convergence, energy assembly or analytic-force owners. Incomplete residency, DF, mixed, incremental, graph-chunk and application-ledger owners retain the ordinary route. Explicit 0 restores raw LR replay; explicit 1 still passes resource and scientific identity gates. Numerical construction or post-mutation failures propagate instead of falling back.
revisit_condition: Retain source-bound complete cold E/F/host-export and frozen-own-density warm evidence on A100 and RTX5090, independent signed Full/LR matrices including screening and f shells, capacity and immutable coefficient/operator/spin gates, actual K action counts and finite auditing. Do not infer a universal GPU ranking or extend to partial/host/disk/DF/mixed sources without separate qualification.
